subject: Proposed MAP & dependency triage for NovaCare — next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novacare.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Discovery notes — MAP draft attached

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call today. I pulled together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) based on what we covered; attaching a lightweight spreadsheet (NovaCare_MAP_v0.1.xlsx) and a short "discovery-notes.txt" with the call recap. High-level items included in the MAP: 

- Milestones: Pilot kickoff, security review complete, contract signature, production rollout
- Owner suggestions: NovaCare security team (security review), Procurement (contracting), Redwood AE/CS (pilot and rollout)
- Target close window options: 1) Dec 15, 2026 (aggressive) 2) Jan 20, 2027 (conservative)
- Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence, procurement terms (standard PO vs. SOW), pilot environment access (VPC peering or dedicated instance)

Ask: please confirm (a) the internal stakeholders I should add to the MAP (owners for security/procurement/IT), and (b) which target close window is realistic given your procurement cadence. If it's helpful, we can also add a separate row for a limited pilot acceptance criteria.

Proposed immediate next steps: 
1) You confirm people + any missing dependencies (by Thu, Dec 2)
2) I update MAP to v0.2 and circulate to your list for sign-off
3) Align on target close and pilot scope in follow-up 30-min call (optional)

Attachments: NovaCare_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet), discovery-notes.txt

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Kimberly Park

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 19:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery notes — MAP draft attached

Thanks, Kimberly — great recap and thanks for the fast turnaround. A few notes from our side after a quick internal check: 

- Stakeholders to add: 
  - Security: Elena Morales (me) and Omar Ruiz (omar.ruiz@novacare.io)
  - Procurement: Jacob Lin (copied) and procurement@novacare.io
  - IT/Network: Priya Shah (priya.shah@novacare.io) — needed for VPC peering
  - Business sponsor: Dr. Anita Rao (anita.rao@novacare.io)

- Dependencies we discovered today: 
  - SOC 2 evidence (we'll need a copy of Redwood's most recent SOC 2 report) — target by Dec 10 for our security committee
  - Procurement expects either a standard PO or a redlined SOW; timeline depends on whether the SOW needs legal review (2–3 weeks)
  - Pilot: we have a QA environment available Dec 6; production access will require a scheduled network window and firewall rules to be completed by IT

Timeline guidance: given procurement and legal cycles, the Dec 15 close is optimistic unless we keep the scope to a limited pilot and use a PO. Jan 20 looks safer for full production. Our preference: pilot in December (use PO), production contract signed by mid-Jan.

I'll confirm availability for a 30-min follow-up next week. Also sending Omar and Priya a separate introduction.

Hi all — quick note from the technical enablement side. Thanks for clarifying the stakeholders, Elena. A couple of points:

- We can produce a SOC 2 package (summary and mapping) and an on-call contact for the security committee by Dec 8 if we prioritize it — will need Elena's OK for a limited distribution list.
- For the pilot, VPC peering is the cleanest path; if IT prefers a hosted tunnel we can provide a managed connection but it takes ~5 business days to provision.
- To keep the Dec timeline viable, propose this adjusted MAP approach: 
  - Milestone A (Pilot limited): scope locked by Dec 6, PO signed by Dec 10, pilot live by Dec 15
  - Milestone B (Production): SOW finalized by Jan 10, signature by Jan 20

Kimberly — I'll update the technical rows in the MAP (network owner, contact, security deliverables) and push v0.2 by 11/30 morning. Also happy to join a 30-min follow-up demo for Priya and Omar.

Cheers,
Rishi
Director, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
